date: Nov 9, 2026 · Week 1 / Day 1 · Visibility & early risk communication

cards.title: Lead with what could break
cards.question: PCIe Gen5 margin is 1.5 dB below target. What is your 15-second update?
cards.selfCheck: Say the release impact first: 'Channel margin is 1.5 dB short; layout signoff is at risk.' Add current evidence, owner, and next checkpoint. Exercise: speak it in 15 seconds.
cards.prompt: Coach me on a 15-second risk-first update for PCIe Gen5 channel loss. Challenge my wording and show a stronger version.

cards.title: Flag the risk before proof
cards.question: TDR suggests a connector discontinuity, but EM correlation is pending. When do you alert the team?
cards.selfCheck: Alert now if the uncertainty may affect a decision. Separate observation from hypothesis: 'TDR shows a step; connector is the leading suspect; EM correlation due tomorrow.'
cards.prompt: Practice proactive escalation when TDR and EM evidence are incomplete. Give a realistic SI/PI stakeholder scenario.

cards.title: Facts, hypothesis, next test
cards.question: A PDN impedance peak appears near 18 MHz. How do you avoid overstating the root cause?
cards.selfCheck: Fact: measured peak at 18 MHz. Hypothesis: capacitor/plane resonance. Next: compare simulation and component ESR sensitivity. State confidence and decision timing.
cards.prompt: Train me to distinguish observation, hypothesis, and proof for an 18 MHz PDN resonance. Include a 30-second update.

cards.title: Translate dB into decisions
cards.question: A program manager hears 'S21 notch at 8 GHz.' What should they hear instead?
cards.selfCheck: Translate technical evidence into system consequence: potential eye-margin or compliance risk, affected build, confidence, and mitigation timing. Avoid claiming failure without correlation.
cards.prompt: Rewrite a technical S21-notch finding for a program manager, layout lead, and SI peer; explain what changes for each audience.

cards.title: End with an owned checkpoint
cards.question: A crosstalk concern is open before layout freeze. What makes your update actionable?
cards.selfCheck: Name owner, test, due time, and release decision: 'I will compare NEXT extraction against budget by 2 PM; layout freeze remains conditional until review.' Exercise: draft a 30-second update.
cards.prompt: Give me a 30-second SI/PI risk update exercise with owner, deadline, evidence, and explicit decision gate. Critique my answer.
